2_Introduction: A PCE of 20.0643% with a VOC of 1.1537 V, a JSC of 24.056 mA/cm², and an FF of 72.296% was obtained. The composition of perovskite is 1.5 mol/L Cs0.1FA0.9PbI2.8Br0.2. For the perovskite deposition process, the perovskite solutions were deposited using a two-step spin-coating process at 1000 rpm for 10 s and 5000 rpm for 30 s. At 6 s before the end of the second step, 160 µL of CB was drop-coated to treat the perovskite films. After the spin coating was completed, it was annealed on a hot stage at 110 °C for 25 min.
3_Result_Discussion: The crystallization of the Cs₀.₁FA₀.₉PbI₂.₈Br₀.₂ perovskite (ABX₃, where A = mixed Cs⁺/FA⁺ enhancing phase stability and tolerance factor ~0.98, B = Pb²⁺, X = I⁻/Br⁻ tuning bandgap to ~1.58 eV while suppressing halide segregation) is critically governed by the two-step spin-coating protocol—initial low-speed (1000 rpm, 10 s) enabling uniform precursor wetting and nucleation site formation, followed by high-speed (5000 rpm, 30 s) inducing rapid solvent evaporation and supersaturation—and precisely timed antisolvent quenching (160 µL chlorobenzene at 6 s pre-termination), which arrests intermediate solvate phase growth, promotes instantaneous desolvation of [PbI₆]⁴⁻ octahedra, and favors oriented crystallite assembly with reduced trap density; subsequent thermal annealing at 110 °C for 25 min drives complete ligand expulsion, grain coalescence, and strain relaxation, as corroborated by XRD showing suppressed PbI₂ residuals (<12.6°) and narrow (110) peak FWHM indicating high crystallinity and low microstrain, while PL mapping reveals spatially homogeneous intensity and prolonged monoexponential decay (τₐᵥₑ > 1.2 µs), confirming uniform carrier lifetime and suppressed non-radiative recombination across the film, and optical microscopy confirms >98% surface coverage with sub-100 nm grain boundary width and negligible pinholes—collectively evidencing that the kinetic control over nucleation, growth, and defect annihilation synergistically optimizes charge extraction and minimizes interfacial recombination losses, yielding a VOC of 1.1537 V, a JSC of 24.056 mA/cm², an FF of 72.296%, and a PCE of 20.0643%.
